hook: A DECam archive search yields 65 outer Solar System candidates, four of them possible Neptune Trojans.
summary: The author linked single-night detections in the NOIRLab Source Catalog DR2 and confirmed candidates with forced photometry on other archival nights, leaving 65 solid candidates. Four are candidate L4 Neptune Trojans, and none beyond 80 au was confirmed, so Planet Nine is barely constrained. End-to-end recall is only about 7% and no selection function is given, so the sample cannot yield population statistics.
title: An Archival Search for Outer Solar System Objects in the NOIRLab Source Catalog DR2: 65 Candidates, Including Four L4 Neptune Trojans
